description: This Java class 'JspViewHandler' implements a view handler for rendering JSP pages within the OFBiz web application framework. It manages the initialization, preparation, and rendering of JSP views, including locating the appropriate RequestDispatcher and handling exceptions during rendering.

classes.name: JspViewHandler
classes.description: A handler class responsible for rendering JSP pages in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initializing the handler, preparing the view context, and rendering JSP pages with appropriate error handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the view handler with the provided ServletContext.

methods.name: prepareViewContext
methods.description: Prepares and returns the context map for the view; currently returns an empty map.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a JSP page specified by 'page' parameter, handling request dispatching and exceptions during inclusion.
